nodes.label: Anonymous Driver Placeholder Image
nodes.description: Grayscale cut-out (transparent background) of a racing driver in full-face helmet with dark visor and race suit, arms crossed. Generic, faceless driver portrait.
nodes.rationale: Used as a fallback/default driver photo in the race overlay when no pilot photo is provided; helmet and dark visor keep identity anonymous and grayscale tones fit any team color palette.
